title: SAFER: Probing Safety in Reward Models with Sparse Autoencoder

bias_targets.methodology: Using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to extract human-interpretable features from reward model activations and evaluating feature responses to prompts containing classist content (e.g., mocking people in affordable housing).

Analyzing Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) feature activations on reward models when evaluating prompts that request harmful stereotypes about specific nationalities or cultural groups (e.g., Koreans, French).
